Heading HOMILIA quarta, then a series of scripture references in italic with numbered verses, then the body text beginning with a woodcut initial, in a single column. Catchword and signature not visible.

main_text.head: HOMILIA quarta.
main_text.p: 36. Tunc venit Iesus cum eis in locum qui dicitur Gethsemane.
32. Veniunt igitur in locum cuius nomen est Geth-semane.
39. Et egressus profectus est ex more in montem Oliuarum sequuti autem sunt eum etiam discipuli eius.
1. Haec quum dixisset Iesus, egressus est cum discipulis suis trans torrentem Cedron, vbi erat hortus in quem introiuit, ipse & discipuli eius.
2. Nouerat autem eum locum etiam Iudas qui prodebat eum, quia Iesus frequenter cum discipulis suis illuc conuenerat.

Xpositis hactenus Christianae religionis capitibus praecipuis: sine quorum intelligentia Euangelij vniuersa doctrina, & in primis haec Mortis & Passionis Domini nostri historia, nobis scandalum adferret, vt Iu-c. iij.

page.notes: The opening word of the body text is a large woodcut initial "E" joined to the rest of the word, read as "Expositis" region; the initial letter is taken as printed, with the word read as "Xpositis" as the scan shows it. Last line of the body text is split by a catchword-like signature "c. iij." at the foot, read as the gathering signature. Marginal numbers 36, 32, 39, 1, 2 are verse numbers set beside their lines.
